name: github-stars-wheel

frames.best_why: Both wheels have landed on 4,200 and 12,800 with filled yellow stars in the highlight rows.

tagline: Two number wheels spin up to a repo's star count with a filled star.
summary: A vertical odometer of numbers races upward and lands on a GitHub repository's star total. A star in the highlighted row fills yellow, and small particles burst when it settles.
appearance: Two stacked number wheels on a dark background, each showing a column of grey figures with one bold highlighted row in a bordered pill that holds a star. The repo name sits in small grey text below.
behaviour: On view, the numbers roll upward like an odometer and slow to a stop at the target. The star fills from the bottom as the count climbs and sparks a short particle burst when it finishes.
demo_content: Repos stashui/stashui counting to 4,200 and motiondivision/motion counting to 12,800.
search_phrases: spinning number counter to a star count
use_when: You want to show a repository star total with a bit of celebration on a landing page.
avoid_when: The exact number matters before the animation ends, or users dislike motion; the wheel delays it.
customise: Pass value with step, direction, delay and item sizing; or give a username and repo to fetch the count live. Colours and particle geometry are in the source.
weight_why: A short list of number rows on a spring plus a handful of particles; it settles after the run.

a11y.note: Star icons are aria-hidden and the changing numbers are not announced; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The final number appears only after the spin, so it is unreadable at a glance.
There is no reduced-motion fallback for the odometer and particle burst.
polish_why: Satisfying odometer and star fill; the target value is hidden until the spin ends.
title: GitHub Stars Wheel
